# Sigstore fixtures

`a.txt` and its bundle `a.txt.sigstore.json` are the `happy-path-v0.3` case of the bundle verification tests of [sigstore-conformance](https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore-conformance), signed through Sigstore's public instance by the identity that `tests/component.rs` names. `trusted_root.json` is the trusted root of Sigstore's public instance as the examples of [sigstore-go](https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore-go) hold it, which covers the bundle's certificate, transparency log entry and certificate timestamp, so that cosign verifies the bundle without reaching Sigstore. Both projects publish them under the Apache License 2.0.
